FINANCE COMMITTEE
MINUTES

‘A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Monday, December 19, 2022, in Committee
Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Jeff White, Chairman, Ken Esquibel, and Richard Johnson (via
Zoom). Absent: Dr. Michelle Aldrich.

AGENDA ITEMS
6. APPLICATIONS/LICENSES/PERMITS:
a) Transfer of ownership of retail liquor license application filed with the City Clerk’s
Office for Railspur, LLC d/b/a Railspur, 707 W. Lincolnway, Cheyenne, WY
(license currently held by Get Bent, LLC).

Mr. Esquibel moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Johnson, Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Kris Jones, City Clerk, provided a staff report and Chad Willett, applicant, was available to answer
questions. Chairman White and committee member Mr. Esquibel commented on the item.

19. RESOLUTION — Authorizing the execution of a Promissory Note to the State of Wyoming
in the amount of $4,862,745.00 to Fund Fire Pension A. (General Fund) (SPONSOR - MR.
WHITE)

Mr. Esquibel moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Johnson. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Stefanie Boster, City Attomey, provided a staff report. Committee member Mr. Esquibel
‘commented on the item.

20, RESOLUTION — Designating local banks as depositories for municipal funds.
(SPONSOR — MR. WHITE),

Mr. Esquibel moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Johnson. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Brenda Moureaux, Deputy City Treasurer, provided a staff report.

21. RESOLUTION — Re-appropriating the Fiscal Year 2023 Budget of the City of Cheyenne
according to the provisions of W. S. §§ 16-4-112 & 16-4-113. (SPONSOR - MR. WHITE)
SS-00077)

Mr. Esquibel moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Johnson. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
